# DPF Camera release notes

## 0.16.6

- Correct backup validation for the exact supported Linux systemd unit filename.
- Preserve strict archive path, file-type, duplicate, file-set and integrity checks.
- Include signed application update management, equivalent online/offline trust,
  verified backups, postinstall checks and rollback from the blocked 0.16.5 candidate.
- Application-only bootstrap from approved 0.16.4; no OS or unattended updates.
- No camera, recording, display, network streaming or health behavior changes.

The immutable 0.16.5 candidate remains blocked. These notes do not establish
production acceptance; approval requires signed metadata and fleet validation.
